items.title: Farioli en FC Porto slepen Portugese Super Cup in de wacht
items.summary: FC Porto heeft zaterdag de eerste prijs van het nieuwe seizoen veroverd. De landskampioen won in de strijd om de Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira, de Portugese Super Cup, met 1-0 van bekerwinnaar Torreense. Pablo Rosario begon daarbij in de basis.

items.title: Danjuma laat voeten spreken na geruchten over vertrek bij Valencia
items.summary: Arnaut Danjuma heeft zich opnieuw nadrukkelijk laten gelden bij Valencia. De 29-jarige aanvaller maakte het enige doelpunt voor de Spaanse club in de oefenwedstrijd tegen Stoke City (1-1), nadat hij eerder deze week ook al twee keer had gescoord in een besloten oefenduel met Derby County.

items.title: Voetbal op TV: hier kijk je naar de strijd om de Johan Cruijff Schaal
items.summary: Landskampioen PSV en bekerwinnaar AZ openen zondag 2 augustus het nieuwe seizoen op klassieke wijze met de strijd om de Johan Cruijff Schaal. VI vertelt waar en hoe je het duel om de eerste prijs van het seizoen kunt bekijken.

items.title: Arsenal pakt eerste prijsje van het seizoen, Van de Beek speelt uur bij Girona
items.summary: Arsenal is de voorbereiding gestart met een overtuigende overwinning op Girona. De ploeg van Mikel Arteta won met 1-4 van de Spaanse club, waar Donny van de Beek in de basis begon en na ruim een uur naar de kant werd gehaald.

items.title: Scottish Premiership: Mayo and Nisbet strike late to help Aberdeen stun Hearts
items.summary: Two stoppage-time goals secured 2-1 win for the hosts Killian Phillips double gives St Mirren 2-0 win at Falkirk Hearts’ miserable summer continued as they conceded two late goals to lose 2-1 to Aberdeen in their Premiership opener at Pittodrie. Wouter Vrancken and Hearts looked on course for a much-needed victory after a turbulent few months as they led through Oisin McEntee’s first-half goal. But just as they looked to be closing out a first win at Pittodrie for more than a decade, Lewis Mayo equalised in the 90th minute before Kevin Nisbet won it for Aberdeen with a stoppage-time penalty after Stuart Findlay was sent off for denying a goal-scoring opportunity. items.title: Transfer news: Welbeck joins Chelsea, Brentford complete record Sangaré deal
items.summary: 35-year-old Brighton striker Welbeck seals £5m move Mali international Sangaré joins Bees for reported £39m Chelsea have signed Brighton’s veteran striker Danny Welbeck in a deal worth a reported £5m. Welbeck has agreed a two-year contract and will link up with Xabi Alonso’s squad on their pre-season tour. The 35-year-old’s move to Stamford Bridge is a break from Chelsea’s policy of signing younger players with the potential to be developed. It is the first time they have paid a transfer fee for a player over the age of 26 since they signed Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang from Barcelona in 2022 when the striker was 33. Continue reading...

items.title: Faster, faster: Iraola in a rush to plug Liverpool gaps before Premier League starts
items.summary: New head coach needs to use the transfer market with defensive cover vital as injuries hamper US pre-season tour “Faster, faster,” bellowed Andoni Iraola throughout the open training session Liverpool held in Chicago on Friday. His first pre-season tour as Liverpool head coach ends at the city’s famous Soldier Field Stadium on Sunday, with a friendly against Leeds, and “faster, faster” could apply to all aspects of the club’s preparations for a new Premier League campaign that begins in three weeks’ time. Iraola was in his element as he immersed himself at the centre of every training drill that Liverpool performed at Chicago Fire’s Endeavor Health Performance Center, their base for the past two weeks in the US. “Faster, faster” was the new head coach’s instruction to his players as three teams of seven worked on their pressing games. He also shouted it when they walked over to a different pitch, recently vacated by Robert Lewandowski and his new Chicago Fire teammates, to work on offensive and defensive set-piece routines. Sprints were demanded following every rondo. Continue reading...

items.title: De Zerbi wants ‘lovely guy’ Richarlison to stay at Tottenham after winner sinks Chelsea
items.summary: 10-man Spurs win pre-season match 2-1 in Sydney ‘He’s important, it’s not easy to find another striker’ Roberto De Zerbi wants Richarlison to stay at Tottenham, but says the striker, who has been linked with a move away, is still unsure about his future. The Brazilian scored a last-gasp winner as 10-man Tottenham defeated Chelsea 2-1 in a pre-season friendly in Sydney, with Kevin Danso sent off just minutes after coming on as a half-time substitute. items.title: There can be no letup. Humiliated Infantino must stand down at Fifa or be removed | Nick Ames
items.summary: Uefa’s call for a boycott and declaration of no-confidence must be the opening salvos in push to dethrone game’s global leader There is no time to dance around the subject. Gianni Infantino must stand down as Fifa president or otherwise be legally removed. No fresh chances can be made available for an official who has demolished trust in football’s integrity and governance, trashing all remaining credibility of the body that oversees the world’s most-cherished sport. Infantino was forced into a humiliating climbdown on Saturday morning when he accepted the failure of his plan to sell off portions of the World Cup to private investment. He resolved to resume dialogue about football’s growth “in the spirit of shared interest in our game”. But such a naked attempt to save his own skin cannot hold. Every day Infantino remains in power is a fresh stain on an institution whose reputation is on the floor. Continue reading...

items.title: Thorup wijst op opvallende reden achter stille Genk-exit in 2020
items.summary: Vijf jaar na zijn abrupte vertrek bij KRC Genk krijgt Jess Thorup eindelijk de kans om uit te leggen waarom hij destijds zonder veel uitleg naar FC Kopenhagen trok. De Deen zegt dat hij door de beursregels van zijn nieuwe club nauwelijks iets mocht communiceren.
